review: VALORIA STRUCTURAL QUALITY BAR REVIEW v1
verdict: STRUCTURAL QUALITY BAR PASS WITH CONTROLLED UPLIFT RECOMMENDATIONS

frame_judgement.commercial_read: The structural core has crossed out of pure/improved greybox: authored defense, circulation and geology now establish a credible game frame skeleton. The complete screen is not yet commercial-finish because deliberately unproduced secondary families still occupy large screen areas.
frame_judgement.convergence: YES — macro silhouette, fortress hierarchy and entry-to-Bastion circulation are genuinely converging toward the canonical target rather than merely polishing the old prototype.
frame_judgement.secondary_scale_safe: YES, with one tightly bounded terrain uplift recommended before/during the next secondary block.

mandatory_questions.1_greybox_or_commercial: Structural core no longer reads as mere greybox, but whole frame is not commercial-finish yet because secondary placeholders/dead areas remain.
mandatory_questions.2_bastion_dominance: PASS. Bastion is the clear upper hero cluster through Keep height, heraldry, mass and elevated placement.
mandatory_questions.3_defensive_family_cohesion: PASS. Lower Gate, Walls and Bastion share warm stone, crenellation/tower vocabulary and blue/gold accents without becoming identical.
mandatory_questions.4_circulation_axis: PASS. Bridge → Lower Gate → Road → Stair → Bastion is immediate and legible in wide/mobile.
mandatory_questions.5_terrain_support: PASS WITH UPLIFT. Macro geology supports terraces convincingly, but the upper Bastion shelf exposes an overly dark continuous seam/band that reads more like a rendering/terrain cut than natural support.
mandatory_questions.6_global_silhouette: PASS. Main target anchors and stepped upper/lower silhouette are retained; missing secondary/background richness explains much of the remaining target gap.
mandatory_questions.7_hierarchy: PASS. Bastion primary; Lower Gate/defensive frame secondary; road/stair/terrain tertiary/support.
mandatory_questions.8_material_value_cohesion: PASS at structural level after Bastion Source08. Remaining flatness is dominated by missing lighting/presentation and unproduced secondary surfaces.
mandatory_questions.9_architectural_depth: PASS structurally. Gates/Bastion/walls have real relief and depth; large empty parcels are not evidence against closed structural architecture.
mandatory_questions.10_valoria_identity: PASS at structural identity level via blue/gold heraldry, reconstruction/damage cues and specific two-gate fortified axis; secondary life is still needed to escape sparse generic-medieval staging.
mandatory_questions.11_mobile: PASS. Entry axis and hero Bastion remain readable in mobile landscape; portrait entry strongly reads Lower Gate/bridge but naturally cannot show the full city hierarchy at once.
mandatory_questions.12_family_below_rest: No family warrants reopening wholesale. Rock/Terrain has one localized integrated defect below the rest: upper-shelf dark seam/band.
mandatory_questions.13_not_solvable_by_secondary: The upper Bastion shelf dark seam is structural and should not be hidden with vegetation/props/lighting alone. Other major gaps can be addressed by secondary families/presentation.
mandatory_questions.14_safe_to_scale: YES. Secondary production is justified; do not redesign the structural frame.

gaps.area: Lower Gate + Bridge + Road + Stair + Walls + Bastion
gaps.finding: Core silhouette, circulation, hierarchy and defensive language are sufficient now; no reopening justified.
Sparse/placeholder occupancy keeps the whole frame from reading inhabited/commercial. Expected to improve with Cabin/Sawmill + Camp and later props.
Current cone trees, flat water/world context and empty edges suppress depth, scale and premium identity. These are explicitly secondary-family gaps.
Current neutral capture flattens contact, atmosphere and material separation. Final lighting/presentation should materially improve depth/value cohesion.

gaps.defect: Continuous very-dark horizontal seam/cut directly below the Bastion terrace, strongest across the upper shelf.
gaps.impact: Breaks natural geological support and reads as a black technical gap beneath the hero asset; secondary dressing should not be used to conceal it.
gaps.minimum_recommended_change: Localized upper-shelf material/geometry/contact uplift only: remove/compress the dark seam and create a believable rock/earth transition under the Bastion while preserving exact macro envelope, camera, Bastion, Stair and all other closed families. No terrain redesign.

recommended_next: Authorize one controlled Rock/Terrain upper-shelf seam uplift, then Cabin / Sawmill + Camp → Vegetation + Water/Shore → Props + Background → Lighting / presentation polish. The secondary block may be prepared after review closure, but no family is opened by this review.
